S1.text:

answer.summary: Paul says the initial unwinding takes six to eight weeks; deeper unwinding may take two to three years if you remain on an uncertain path.

sections.heading: How long it takes
sections.content: Paul says it takes six to eight weeks just to unwind initially. He adds that deeper unwinding—starting to trust yourself more—may take two to three years if you stay on the uncertain path.

judgment.explanation: Paul says it takes six to eight weeks just to unwind initially. The answer gives that timeframe and accurately distinguishes it from the deeper unwinding he says may take two to three years.

previous_judgments.explanation: The answer correctly says Paul Millerd found it took six to eight weeks to unwind initially, supported by S1. Its additional point about deeper unwinding taking two to three years is also supported by S1 and S2.
